authority.basis: 2026-09-08 user: 끝까지 실험 계획 세우고 실행하라.
authority.scope: one prospective source39 development prior study, including source-only native export, fits, outcomes, audit and terminal report

source_projection.provenance: previouslyverifiedsource39projection; inherits float32 impedance precision; no freshindependentM; not raw-original-precisionreplay

preprocessing.operator: for EACH N separately raw[:,125:160+N] -> unchanged native preprocess (47–53Hz Cheby1 bandstop) -> unchanged native filterbank(5) with detrend/ddof1 zscore -> discard35 samples; shape[5,8,N]; no extra filtering/resampling/centering
preprocessing.claim_boundary: query-end bounded and .14s available history, within-window filtfilt, upstream downsampling not independently verified; not full acquisition causality

upstream.license: README CC BY-NC-SA4.0; toolbox-author Python implementation, not original2018authorMATLAB

q_helper.fit_scope: separately for each interface/window/band, budgets pooled, participant grouped

q: log off-reference power fraction using centered 5harmonic QR basis real codebook
mean pairwise one-minus centered support correlation
features.m: support-only log1p(kOhm), mean centered over available channels, population SD; zero valid, NaN missing, no oracle or query M
features.q_numeric: relativepower floor1e-12; off-reference power denominator floor1e-12 and fraction clip[1e-6,1]; centered pairwise correlation clipped[-1,1], reject denominator<=1e-24; QR of centered real-codebook sin/cos harmonics1..5

learning.outer_split: sorted subject rank modulo3; all conditions/budgets/channels of a person stay together
learning.residual_target: y minus participant-nested-OOF Q from same outer training participants
learning.q2: same chosen Q representation; fixed residual fit
learning.sham: For each interface/k and fit or eval partition separately, group by headband_order and entire k-by8 finite-mask tuple; sort each group by subjectID, assign each recipient next sorted member cyclically (np.roll(sorted_indices,-1)); singleton maps to self; same mapping all windows/bands; no random search
learning.stale: repeat first support packet k times; intersect recipient observed mask
learning.missing: numeric denial with common Q mask retained; exact Q prior/prediction fallback

anchor: A0 at k0 on same48queries; not repeated as independent budget result

endpoints.primary: 39participant mean of eight condition QM3-Q3 differences; descriptive t38 95CI
endpoints.control_gate: primary mean>=.01 and lowerCI>0; QM3-Q2 and QM3-SHAM lowerCI>0; eval M-feature changed fraction>=.5
endpoints.calibration_gate: control_gate AND QM3-Q5 lowerCI>-.01 AND meanQM3>=.8 AND mean labels(QM)-labels(Q)<0 among both reached AND new_reach>=lost_reach
endpoints.ci_scope: descriptive development participant variability; repeated cohort and overlapping CV training forbid independent confirmation
endpoints.report: all cells/arms; help tie harm; native compatibility; proxy level/shape; prior/filter/score/decision changes; sham/missing coverage; reachability transitions and finite-pair label differences separately
endpoints.coverage: primaryk3:78 participant×interface cells; correct vs evalPERMUTED donor M two-feature arrays, any absolute difference>1e-12; denominator includes singleton/identical features; same donor as SHAM_REFIT evaluation
endpoints.calibration_aggregation: all312 participant×interface×window cells: count both/new/lost/neither reached; arithmetic mean QMlabels-Qlabels over all both-reached cells (pooled, not participant conditionalmeans); zero both-reached => mean null and calibration gate false; new/lost counts acrossall312

execution.infrastructure_recovery: preserve failed attempt; allow only code/transport fixes that preserve frozen scientific settings, using separate receipts; no outcome-based candidate change

native_cache.manifest: native/result.json binds start, plan SHA, source commit, source hashes, raw hashes/dtypes and39file hashes; complete status required

terminal: VALIDITY_FAILURE or METADATA_INCREMENT_NOT_ESTABLISHED or CLASSIFICATION_INCREMENT_ONLY or DEVELOPMENT_CALIBRATION_BENEFIT_CANDIDATE; all branches end this one candidate. No automatic held opening or post-outcome gamma/window/seed/operator search.
